EGY.note: Only the data protection portal's national ID sign-up is mentioned; no authentication service is described.
Nothing on civil register or ID links.
A national data centre strategy is planned for year end, but it concerns data centre regulation, not where state data is hosted.
Capacity of 15 to 60 MW and licensing by NTRA are stated, but no facility is said to rent to others in service, and no Tier or cloud region.

facts.fact: The new Personal Data Protection Center oversees personal data in Egypt and launched its online portal in October 2026, according to Enterprise.
Egypt began fully enforcing its 2020 data protection law in early November 2026, per Enterprise.
The executive regulations of the 2020 data protection law came out in 2025 with a one-year compliance grace period, per Enterprise.
facts.system: Executive regulations of the data protection law

facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Center oversees personal data and launched its online portal in October 2026, per Enterprise.
The data protection regulator launched an online sign-up portal in October 2026, which Enterprise says was barely working the week before 12 November.

EGY.note: Transfer permits and a central bank rule on bank data are described; no rule on government data and no planned state-data goal is stated.

facts.fact: Enterprise lists undersea cables connecting Egypt to North and Sub-Saharan Africa, Europe and Asia among its existing components for a data centre hub.
